propositions: The fixture-level equivalence test required a single call to build_ticket_position_commit_map to return a complete map, but the production implementation explicitly fails closed to empty dict on any Git transient (rc nonzero, empty output, or process exception)

Runtime injection of rc=128/empty, rc=0/empty, and BlockingIOError(EAGAIN) each reproduced the organic CI sequence: first batched call returned {}, an immediate identical replay against the unchanged repository returned all 8 position-to-SHA pairs
The test harness lacked bounded Git-read recovery despite the same pattern being established in tests/_git_counts.py for other transient read boundaries
Fix adds fixture-only _fixture_batched_map that performs at most five exact resolver attempts, returns on first complete map, and raises with fsck/count-objects diagnostics on persistent failure
Both direct equivalence assertions and optimization-count assertions now use the bounded recovery seam without weakening exact position-to-commit expectations
